context: Mei and Aoi shop for a phone case.
purpose: Casual register; daily vocabulary (ケース/モノ/セット/ビル/倍) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: スマホのケースを、探しているの。
lines.en: I'm looking for a phone case.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あのビルのお店、品揃えがいいよ。
lines.en: The shop in that building has good selection.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ケースとフィルムの、セットがいいな。
lines.en: A case-and-film set would be nice.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: セットだと、安くなるモノも多いよ。
lines.en: As a set, many things are cheaper.
lines.style: helpful barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 単品だと、倍の値段なんだって。
lines.en: Bought separately, it's twice the price.
lines.style: surprised woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ、セットの方がお得なモノだね。
lines.en: Then the set is the better deal.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あのビルの上の階に、あるかな?
lines.en: Is it on the upper floor of that building?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 行ってみよう。いいケース、見つかるよ!
lines.en: Let's go. You'll find a good case!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
